why_it_matters: Two record-boundary facts, closing the reconnaissance half of the post-0127 program state. (1) FRONTIER: the route-C option for hOff (extend the verified zero-exclusion record above tPT2) has NO immediate external input: Platt and Trudgian's interval-arithmetic verification to 3,000,175,332,800 (arXiv:2004.09765; Bulletin of the London Mathematical Society 53(3), 2021) remains the public record (checked against the BLS publication record, the arXiv record, the Mathematics of Computation isolation paper for the 3.06e10 predecessor record, and the Wikipedia Riemann-hypothesis article, which cites Platt-Trudgian 3.0001753328e12 as 'the most extensive computer search'). The in-tree frontier WinC.tPT2 therefore stays put, and the 0106/0108 shrink pattern (which would apply automatically to the now-unified hOff face if a higher record appeared - the face-identity machinery WinC.faceSplitH / faceResidualMonotone is in place) has no input. (2) MEASURED SHADOW COMPLETE: the S35B pre-check (now overflow-guarded and re-run to completion) confirms the B10.1 body inequality's margin uniformly over the full surveyed height range [1e3, 3e12], including AT the frontier height: the squeeze certificate wire + mass < devProg has measured relative margin at least 1.1136 (11.36%) at the band edge at every surveyed height to the frontier, and the margin grows monotonically in d0 to ~1.1e4 at the sigma-0 slice. The witness-level (per-actual-zero) shadow remains vacuous below the frontier by the record itself (all zeros there are on the line - there are no off-line witnesses to shadow); the pair-level (function-of-trial-points) shadow - which is what the squeeze certificate consumes - is now measured end-to-end, from the machine band start to the record height. Net: the program sits at a clean record boundary - one open exclusion face hOff above tPT2, with its squeeze certificate measured to the frontier and no external record to extend it. The live program paths are: (C) frontier-extension watch (re-check periodically for a successor to 3.0001753328e12; on appearance, the shrink applies automatically in body); the B6 packet item-4 audit (the 31k-line dependency patch - the main human check on the [Z78] input); and in-tree archival consolidation (the 0121-0127 correction chain is complete; the PATHWAY current-state section can be rewritten to the final ledger: [Z-PT2] record + one open face hOff + [Z78]). No RH claim.
